title: Birth of the Blues
description: A New Orleans clarinetist (Bing Crosby) forms a Dixieland jazz band with a trumpet player (Brian Donlevy) from Memphis.

title: Girl Crazy
description: A publisher's playboy son (Mickey Rooney) falls for the dean's granddaughter (Judy Garland) at an all-male mining school.

title: Strike Up the Band
description: A drummer (Mickey Rooney) and his singer girlfriend (Judy Garland) form a high-school swing band for a radio contest.

title: Pot o' Gold
description: A harmonica player (James Stewart) woos a landlady's daughter (Paulette Goddard) and joins a conductor's (Horace Heidt) orchestra.

title: God Is My Co-Pilot
description: Col. Robert L. Scott Jr. (Dennis Morgan) becomes a member of Gen. Chennault's (Raymond Massey) Flying Tigers in World War II.

title: My Wild Irish Rose
description: Irish balladeer Chauncey Olcott charms Lillian Russell and an alderman's daughter in the 1890s New York.

title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
description: A Brooklyn cabby (Jack Carson) and his manicurist girlfriend (Joan Leslie) meet a prince (Dennis Morgan) posing as a guy from Milwaukee.

title: The Desert Song
description: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Ten Tall Men
description: A Foreign Legion sergeant (Burt Lancaster) and his rowdy men settle tribal trouble by seizing a princess (Jody Lawrance).

title: Sweet Smell of Success
description: An all-powerful New York gossip columnist (Burt Lancaster) gives a press agent (Tony Curtis) some dirty work.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
description: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang.

title: Come Back, Little Sheba
description: A housewife (Shirley Booth) and her alcoholic husband (Burt Lancaster) rent a spare room to a pretty student (Terry Moore).

title: Trapeze
description: Two aerialists (Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis) and a tumbler (Gina Lollobrigida) form a triple-somersault circus triangle.

title: Jim Thorpe, All American
description: Coach Pop Warner (Charles Bickford) recalls the Oklahoma Indian (Burt Lancaster) forced to return his medals from the 1912 Olympics.

title: It's Always Fair Weather
description: A talk-show staffer (Cyd Charisse) puts a fight manager (Gene Kelly), adman (Dan Dailey) and cook on TV 10 years after they parted as GIs.

title: The Lost Squadron
description: A Prussian director (Erich von Stroheim) demands realism from a Hollywood stunt pilot (Richard Dix) and his buddies.

title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
description: An innocent man is sent to a prison farm, where he endures the dehumanizing effects of a cruel criminal justice system.

title: Key Largo
description: A gangster (Edward G. Robinson) holds a GI (Humphrey Bogart) and others hostage in a run-down Florida Keys hotel.

title: The Subject Was Roses
description: A World War II veteran (Martin Sheen) comes home to his bickering parents (Patricia Neal, Jack Albertson).

title: Some Came Running
description: An ex-GI writer (Frank Sinatra) hangs out with a gambler (Dean Martin) and a floozy (Shirley MacLaine) in his hometown.

title: Till the End of Time
description: Three servicemen return from World War II: one (Guy Madison) loves a war widow (Dorothy McGuire) ; another one (Robert Mitchum) drinks in pain.

title: In Harm's Way
description: Two Navy officers (John Wayne, Kirk Douglas) fight guilt and the Japanese in the World War II Pacific.

title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
description: A British POW colonel (Alec Guinness) orders his men to build their Japanese captor (Sessue Hayakawa) a railway bridge in the jungle.

title: The Deer Hunter
description: The horrors of Vietnam affect three Pennsylvania steelworkers (Robert De Niro, Christopher Walken, John Savage), lifelong friends who serve together.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: The Fox
description: A man (Keir Dullea) divides two lesbians (Sandy Dennis, Anne Heywood) who intentionally isolated themselves in a remote farmhouse.

title: Sweet November
description: A tragic New Yorker (Sandy Dennis) loves a different man a month; the one for November (Anthony Newley) wants to stay.

title: High Society
description: A socialite's (Grace Kelly) ex-husband (Bing Crosby) and a magazine writer (Frank Sinatra) show up for her wedding and cause havoc.

title: Green Fire
description: An emerald miner's (Stewart Granger) digging in Colombia leaves his girlfriend's (Grace Kelly) coffee plantation open to a flood.

title: Mogambo
description: A chorus girl (Ava Gardner) and a married woman (Grace Kelly) fight over a white hunter (Clark Gable) in Africa.

title: Dial M for Murder
description: A husband's plot to murder his unfaithful wife goes awry in Alfred Hitchcock's adaptation of the Frederick Knott play.

title: The Swan
description: A European princess (Grace Kelly) waltzes with her tutor (Louis Jourdan) but is destined to marry a crown prince (Alec Guinness).

title: Love With the Proper Stranger
description: Pregnancy surprises a working girl (Natalie Wood) and a trumpet player (Steve McQueen) from Italian families in New York.

title: Come September
description: An American (Rock Hudson) visits his Italian villa in the off season and catches his caretaker running it as a hotel.

title: Same Time, Next Year
description: A California housewife (Ellen Burstyn) and a married New Jersey accountant (Alan Alda) have an annual affair for 26 years, starting in 1951.

title: The Man in the Moon
description: A couple's (Sam Waterston, Tess Harper) two daughters catch the eye of their new teenage neighbor in 1957 Louisiana.

title: Up the Down Staircase
description: A novice teacher (Sandy Dennis) finds hostile students and staff apathy at a tough New York high school.

title: In the Cool of the Day
description: A British publisher (Peter Finch) with a nagging wife (Angela Lansbury) falls in love with a doomed American (Jane Fonda) in Greece.

title: Sunday in New York
description: An innocent upstater (Jane Fonda) visits her airline-pilot brother (Cliff Robertson) and meets a stranger (Rod Taylor) she tries to seduce.

title: Thirteen Women
description: Remembering the slights she suffered at the hands of her classmates, a young woman plans an unusual form of vengeance.

title: The Thirteenth Chair
description: A medium holds a seance to clear her daughter of murder in colonial India.
